cola.opt.consolas.h: Ticked, each worker opens its own console window. Unticked they run hidden and are followed from the Log tab.
cola.opt.keep.h: When the video finishes encoding it is compared with the original track: if it came out bigger and the picture is untouched (no crop, scaling, tone-mapping or fps change), the encoded one is thrown away and the original is used. The audio and subtitles already done are kept. It is saved in the configuration and is the starting value for NEW jobs; each file carries it in its job and it can be changed in its editor (or in several at once).
